title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 76
description: Ten questions on Psalms 76: God known in Judah, his dwelling in Zion, and his judgment that silences the earth.

questions.text: In which land is God known, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel."

questions.text: Where is God's tabernacle, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion."

questions.text: What did God break there, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war.

answers.text: The flaming arrows of the bow

questions.text: God is glorious and excellent more than what?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game."

questions.text: What is cast into a dead sleep at God's rebuke?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep."

questions.text: How did the earth respond when God pronounced judgment from heaven?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "The earth feared, and was silent."

questions.text: Why did God arise to judgment, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says God arose to judgment to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.

answers.text: To crown a new king over Israel
To build a temple on the mountain
To dry up the sea and the rivers
To save all the afflicted ones of the earth

questions.text: What does verse 10 say praises God?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says: "Surely the wrath of man praises you."

questions.text: What does verse 11 say to do with vows to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them!"

questions.text: Whose spirit will God cut off, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "He will cut off the spirit of princes."
